title: Fuel Weighs
logbook: Four boxes put her down to her marks with no room for the 2 t the passage burns; the 2 t box stayed ashore and the bunkers took its place.

title: The Stripe
logbook: The 4 t box paid best, but any box beside it put her in the LADEN band; leaving it ashore kept her LIGHT on 2 t of bunkers instead of 4.

title: Two Calls
logbook: The 5 t Oslo box paid best, but it rode both legs and kept her LADEN to Oslo; the 5 t Aarhus box came off halfway and she sailed the long leg LIGHT.

title: Overload
logbook: The 5 t Aberdeen box paid $11, but it put her in the DEEP band on the Teesport–Aberdeen leg; leaving it ashore saved 2 t of bunkers.

title: Full & Down
logbook: One load and no other: the 4 t Rotterdam box, the 4 t Rotterdam box and the 2 t Rotterdam box with 4 t of bunkers put her on the mark at Felixstowe, and she berthed at Rotterdam on the reserve.

title: Leave Room
logbook: Filling her with the 3 t Stavanger box at Esbjerg left no room for the Immingham pickup; sailing 2 t light into Immingham paid $7 at Stavanger.

title: Coastwise
logbook: Filling her with the 2 t Bremerhaven box at Stavanger left no room for the Kiel pickup; keeping room for it paid $12 at Bremerhaven.

title: Round the Skaw
logbook: Filling her with the 2 t Den Helder box at Rotterdam left no room for the Aarhus pickup; sailing 1 t light into Aarhus paid $9 at Den Helder.

title: The Feeder Charter
logbook: The 3 t Bremerhaven box paid $12, but it rode every leg; the 5 t Stavanger box came off at Stavanger and she sailed on lighter.

title: Dry Port
logbook: No bunkers at Turku: the fuel for the Turku–Stockholm leg came from Kotka, 3 t stemmed there, and every tonne of it weighed on the first leg, so the 5 t Stockholm box stayed ashore.

title: Carry It
logbook: No bunkers at Tallinn: the fuel for the Tallinn–Riga leg came from Helsinki, 6 t stemmed there, and every tonne of it weighed on the first leg, so the 3 t Riga box stayed ashore.

title: Short Stem
logbook: Filling her with the 4 t Copenhagen box at Kiel left no room for the Lübeck pickup; sailing 6 t light into Lübeck paid $12 at Gothenburg.

title: Baltic Gale
logbook: Filling her with the 5 t Gdynia box at Szczecin left no room for the Gdynia pickup; sailing 3 t light into Gdynia paid $6 at Gdańsk.

title: To the Tonne
logbook: One load and no other: the 1 t Gdynia box, the 1 t Gdynia box and the 3 t Gdańsk box with 6 t of bunkers put her on the mark at Szczecin, and she berthed at Gdańsk on the reserve.

title: Never Bury
logbook: The small Tallinn boxes filled the second stack at Kotka, and the Helsinki box for Riga had nowhere to stand: nothing may sit on a box that leaves earlier. Stack the Tallinn boxes together and keep a bay clear.

title: Last On, First Off
logbook: Filling her with the 5 t Copenhagen box at Kiel left no room for the Lübeck pickup; keeping room for it paid $5 at Copenhagen.

title: The Sound
logbook: At Turku par takes the 5 t Kotka box and leaves the 2 t Helsinki box: it paid $8 at Kotka and kept her in a cheaper band.

title: The Baltic Charter
logbook: The 5 t Klaipėda box paid $12, but it rode every leg; the 3 t Gdańsk box came off at Gdańsk and she sailed on lighter.

title: Over the Bar
logbook: The Reni bar takes her at 5 t: deliver first, burn down to it, and bunker after the bar; the 2 t Reni box would have kept her too deep.

title: Sulina Pilot
logbook: Filling her with the 4 t Mykolaiv box at Chornomorsk left no room for the Pivdennyi pickup; sailing 4 t light into Pivdennyi paid $7 at Mykolaiv.

title: Deliver First
logbook: The 5 t Mykolaiv box rode every leg; the 3 t Batumi box came off at Batumi and she sailed on lighter.

title: Low Water
logbook: At Izmail par takes the 3 t Reni box and leaves the 2 t Galați box: it paid $6 at Reni and kept her in a cheaper band.

logbook: One load and no other: the 2 t Burgas box, the 2 t Burgas box, the 3 t Varna box and the 2 t Varna box with 5 t of bunkers put her on the mark at Istanbul, and she berthed at Varna on the reserve.

logbook: The 4 t Varna box paid $12, but it put her in the LADEN band on the Istanbul–Burgas leg; leaving it ashore saved 1 t of bunkers.

title: Danube Barge
logbook: Filling her with the 1 t Mykolaiv box at Chornomorsk left no room for the Pivdennyi pickup; sailing 2 t light into Pivdennyi paid $5 at Mykolaiv.

title: Bosphorus Current
logbook: At Izmail par takes the 5 t Reni box and leaves the 2 t Galați box: it paid $12 at Reni and kept her in a cheaper band.

title: The Black Sea Charter
logbook: Filling her with the 4 t Batumi box at Pivdennyi left no room for the Samsun pickup; keeping room for it paid $3 at Batumi.

title: Price Board
logbook: Bunkers were $2 at Algeciras and $3 at Marsaxlokk: par stems 3 t at Algeciras, and not a tonne more than the marks allow; it saved $12 on the stem.

title: Cheap Here
logbook: The 3 t Salalah box paid $12, but it put her in the DEEP band for 2 legs; leaving it ashore saved 3 t of bunkers.

title: Shallow Stem
logbook: Filling her with the 4 t Jeddah box at Piraeus left no room for the Suez pickup; keeping room for it paid $6 at Jeddah.

logbook: One load and no other: the 4 t Gibraltar box, the 4 t Gibraltar box and the 3 t Algeciras box with 3 t of bunkers put her on the mark at Las Palmas, and she berthed at Algeciras on the reserve.

title: Barge Lots
logbook: Djibouti sells bunkers in lots of 2: par stems 6 t there and plans the cargo round the barge, not the other way about.

title: Four or Seven
logbook: Filling her with the 4 t Marsaxlokk box at Port Said left no room for the Piraeus pickup; keeping room for it paid $6 at Marsaxlokk.

title: Bab-el-Mandeb
logbook: The 4 t Salalah box paid $9, but it put her in the DEEP band for every leg; leaving it ashore saved 8 t of bunkers.

title: The Bunker Charter
logbook: Filling her with the 4 t Jeddah box at Port Said left no room for the Jeddah pickup; sailing 5 t light into Jeddah paid $12 at Salalah.

title: Heavy Below
logbook: Heavy below light: the 5 t Manila box had to go to the bottom of its stack, and that decided what else could stand on it.

title: Bottom Weight
logbook: The 1 t Tanjung Pelepas box rode every leg; the 4 t Port Klang box came off at Port Klang and she sailed on lighter.

title: Transhipment
logbook: Filling her with the 5 t Ho Chi Minh City box at Hong Kong left no room for the Hai Phong pickup; keeping room for it paid $5 at Ho Chi Minh City.

title: Malacca Strait

title: Full and Square
logbook: One load and no other: the 5 t Shanghai box and the 4 t Shanghai box with 6 t of bunkers put her on the mark at Busan, and she berthed at Ningbo on the reserve.

title: Plugged In
logbook: The 1 t Singapore reefer paid $6, but a reefer burns a tonne a leg and takes a plugged stack; par leaves it ashore.

title: Cold Chain
logbook: Filling her with the 5 t Xiamen box at Hong Kong left no room for the Yantian pickup; sailing 6 t light into Yantian paid $7 at Xiamen.

title: Sealed

title: Banana Boat

title: Charter Party

title: Gatun Night
logbook: The 4 t Turbo box paid $10, but it put her in the DEEP band for 2 legs; leaving it ashore saved 10 t of bunkers.
